Name: The Corrupted Garden 1.5 Only
Author: ImShawn
Description:
[center][b][u][size=6]The Corrupted Garden
[/size][/u][/b][size=1]
[u]4/7/2024[/u] - This mod won't be updated to 1.6 at the time. I will be updating it to 1.6 eventually but I don't give an actual ETA on it. I am pretty busy, and I currently don't have time for it.
I don't give permission for it to be updated to 1.6 unless asked to.

[u]Only open at night![/u]
[/size]
Meet a new merchant (who isn't an NPC yet) who sells a wide variety of new and old crops, only the crops have been corrupted with the void!  He doesn't only sell crops, he also sells new weapons, and he doesn't take coin. To get your hands on these new weapons, you must bring him Crimsonite Ore, a new ore that spawns the Skull Caverns.


[u][b][size=6]THE SHOP IS OPEN 6am - 2am
[/size][/b][/u]

[u][b][size=6]ATTENTION

[/size][/b][/u]This mod is barely done, I still have a lot of vanilla crops to do and redoing the new ones. If you find any bugs, please let me know!

[b][u][size=6]The Crops
[/size][/u][/b]

The crops are recolored vanilla crops with some new additions like the Carrot. These crops are worth quite a bit (I'm still balancing them to be worth more than regular crops).
Void Crops can only be planted inside a green house or a garden pot. They can be planted outside but will wither the next day.

[b][u][size=6]Fruit Trees
[/size][/u][/b]Fruit trees have been added as of 4.0

Fruit Trees will grow anywhere, but they won't grow fruit unless they're inside or on Ginger Island.

[/b][/u]
As of 4.0 there are no plants to make custom fruit trees... yet!


[u][size=6][b]New Recipes
[/b][/size][/u]

There is a bunch of new recipes and more to come! Use crops from the mod, vanilla crops, and even animal products to make new recipes that give amazing buffs.


[b][u][size=6]New Weapons
[/size][/u][/b]

Find the new ore in the caverns to get your hand on the new weapons (currently 4) from the shopkeeper. They are pretty strong and meant to be better over Galaxy weapons.

[The Weapons are designs I got off of Itch.io that were free to use and I just recolored them]

Crimsonite Blade - [url=https://dreamgryphon.itch.io/pretty-pastels?download]Pretty Pastels by DreamGryphon[/url]﻿
Crimsonite Sword - [url=https://soulofkiran.itch.io/medieval-fantasy-volume-one?download]Medieval Fantasy - Volume 1[/url]﻿
Crimsonite Mace - [url=https://soulofkiran.itch.io/medieval-fantasy-volume-one?download]Medieval Fantasy - Volume 1[/url]﻿
Death's Gaze [i][size=1](Super Powerful) - [/size][url=https://soulofkiran.itch.io/medieval-fantasy-volume-one?download][size=3]Medieval Fantasy - Volume 1[/size][/url]﻿[/i]

[u][size=6][b]New Ore[/b][/size]
[/u]
There is now a new ore known as Crimsonite and it can be found in the Skull Caverns. From floor 11 and beyond. You must search for a black and red crystal and use the crystal you find on a smelter to get a full bar. Though don't use all of them on bars, as only the weapons need bars to get, the rest are traded for the ore itself.[/center]
